header.name: Load Schedule Management Web Flow
header.description: Screen web flow for Load Schedule Management actions

data.messageTransform: "Load ID and Number must be provided"

formInputs.label: Number
formInputs.description: Shipment line number, also the label field.
formInputs.name: Number

formInputs.label: Carrier
formInputs.description: Manually entered Carrier - Use this only if the carrier is not added to the system.
formInputs.name: Carrier

formInputs.label: External Id
formInputs.description: Links out to other system
formInputs.name: External Id

formInputs.label: C Load Carrier
formInputs.description: This is the actual Carrier who is transporting the load.
formInputs.name: C Load Carrier

formInputs.label: Facility
formInputs.description: This is the Originating Facility of the Load - (i.e. First Pick up point)
formInputs.name: Facility

formInputs.label: Image
formInputs.description: Load Image
formInputs.name: Image

formInputs.label: Load Carrier
formInputs.description: This is the Broker  for the Load  - needs to be configured in the Load Carrier table as a broker. This can be the same as the actual Carrier.
formInputs.name: Load Carrier

formInputs.label: Location
formInputs.description: This is the Dock Type Location for this load.
formInputs.name: Location

data.query:
query Query($where: LoadWhereInput, $orderBy: [LoadOrderByInput!], $first: Int, $after: String) {
  load(where: $where, orderBy: $orderBy, first: $first, after: $after) {
    edges {
      node {
        id
        number
        appointmentNumber
        carrier
        externalId
        freightTerms
        note
        proNumber
        specialInstructions
        trackingNumber
        trailerNumber
        arriveAt
        departAt
        scheduledAt
        charges
        customData
        integrationData
        grossWeight {
          value
          unitId
        }
        cLoadCarrierId
        cLoadCarrier {
          id
          code
          broker
          carrier
          usable
          conveyanceCode
          description
          externalId
          name
          number
          scac
          customData
          integrationData
        }
        facilityId
        facility {
          id
          code
          active
          addressee
          externalId
          name
          customData
          integrationData
          supplierAddressId
          typeId
        }
        imageId
        image {
          id
          name
          url
          mimeType
          thumbnailUrl
        }
        loadCarrierId
        loadCarrier {
          id
          code
          broker
          carrier
          usable
          conveyanceCode
          description
          externalId
          name
          number
          scac
          customData
          integrationData
        }
        loadStageId
        loadStage {
          id
          code
          active
          cancelled
          complete
          default
          extDefault
          hold
          loaded
          loading
          new
          staged
          staging
          system
          usable
          color
          description
          message
          name
          customData
          integrationData
        }
        loadTypeId
        loadType {
          id
          name
          air
          ocean
          parcel
          railway
          refrigerated
          system
          truck
          usable
          color
          customData
        }
        locationId
        location {
          id
          name
          externalId
          customData
          facilityId
          locationStatusId
          locationTypeId
          locationGroupId
          zoneId
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

data.mutation:
mutation Mutation($payload: [LoadUpdatePayloadInput!]!) {
  updateLoad(payload: $payload) {
    id
    number
    appointmentNumber
    carrier
    externalId
    freightTerms
    note
    proNumber
    specialInstructions
    trackingNumber
    trailerNumber
    arriveAt
    departAt
    scheduledAt
    charges
    customData
    integrationData
    cLoadCarrierId
    facilityId
    imageId
    loadCarrierId
    loadStageId
    loadTypeId
    locationId
  }
}

data.messageTransform:
"Load #"
& $state.context.REQUEST.DATA.number
& "(ID: "
& $state.context.REQUEST.DATA.id
& "} Is Inactive. It cannot be updated."
